author: KEXP
description: Singaporean shoegaze band motifs shimmer under lush dream pop textures and glistening guitars. In our latest Live on KEXP session at AXEAN Festival, the band share a performance of "Aug 16" and more.
title: motifs perform "Aug 16" & more Live on KEXP at AXEAN Festival
